description: For someone who runs a machine, their own or a VPS rented elsewhere, and wants to sell its compute; to get a machine to use, call rent_create_sandbox instead. The guide for running a machine as a rent.dev node, as Markdown: whether supply is open on this deployment, the two ways to run a node, every step with its exact command, each node state and what to do next, every check with its fix, every problem, rates and the holdback. Read it before rent_supply_enroll. Needs no scope, and the public endpoint serves it too.
